answer_1.quote: We design a methodology for human verification of reasoning chains, and employ it to annotate a dataset of CoT-format reasoning chains generated by three LMs in open-domain complex-reasoning QA tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Chain-of-Thought reasoning chains for complex questions

answer_2.quote: Given the unbalanced class distribution, we report macro-F1 performance in Tab. 3 (class F1 results are in §B).

answer_3.quote: We use Flan-UL2 (20B), Flan-PaLM (540B), and GPT-3 for LM baselines in few-shot prompting settings (prompt templates detailed in §B).

answer_4.quote: We use a pool of 13 English-speaking annotators, and collect 5 annotations per question and its corresponding CoT answer, for each of our two tasks (see §3).
answer_4.guideline: Task 1: Relevance, Type, Logic, and Justification. Task 2: Relevance and Attribution to evidence with justification.
